description: This file defines interfaces for grain call filters in the Orleans framework, specifically for incoming and outgoing grain call filters, including their Invoke methods that process call contexts.

classes.name: IIncomingGrainCallFilter
classes.description: Interface for incoming grain call filters, providing an Invoke method to process incoming grain calls.

classes.name: IOutgoingGrainCallFilter
classes.description: Interface for outgoing grain call filters, providing an Invoke method to process outgoing grain calls.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Method to invoke the filter logic for the grain call, accepting a call context and returning a Task.
